## Install

It lands in `src/rost/spinner/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/spinner.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | enum | `small` `medium` | `medium` |
| `label` | string |  | `Loading` |

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<span role="status">` with the label. It holds the ring and its turning arc.
- `track`: The whole ring, in the tertiary grey.
- `arc`: A quarter of the ring in the positive green, over the track. It's what turns: one turn every 600ms, at an even speed.

## When to use

- **A short wait you can't measure.** Saving, sending, signing in: a second or two with no way to say how far along it is.
- **Inside a button.** In place of the button's icon while its action runs, at `small`. Keep the label, and disable the button.

## When not to use

- **Waits you can measure.** An upload or an import with a count. That's **Progress**.
- **Content that's loading.** A list or a card on its way. Show its shape with **Skeleton**, so the page doesn't jump.

## Behaviour

A grey ring with a green quarter turning once every 600ms. For someone who's asked for less motion it turns five times slower; I didn't stop it, because a still spinner looks like something broke. The picture in Figma is its first frame.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `<span role="status">`, so the label is read when it appears.
- **Name**: `label`. Say what's happening, not "Spinner".
- **Colour**: The green arc is 9:1 on the dark page. The grey ring is decoration.

## Content

The label in sentence case, as a present participle: "Saving".
